profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Self-taught software engineer who began programming at 14 and entered professional software engineering at 19, with roughly 16 years of programming experience including 10+ years professionally.

My professional background is primarily backend and full-stack development with Java, Spring, databases, distributed systems, AWS, and JavaScript/TypeScript, but I do not treat job titles or abstraction boundaries as limits on what I should understand. I tend to follow difficult problems downward until I understand the mechanism causing them, whether that means application architecture, database concurrency, production diagnostics, security boundaries, infrastructure, runtime behavior, or unfamiliar code.

I value testability, observability, explicit security boundaries, and engineering decisions grounded in actual system behavior. I would rather identify and eliminate the root cause of a recurring problem than normalize it, repeatedly work around it, or declare a task complete because a process says it is done. I approach systems adversarially and spend a lot of time considering failure modes, unintended behavior, and assumptions that may not hold in production.

I also use automation and AI agents extensively as engineering leverage without outsourcing technical judgment or verification. I build agent tooling, retrieval systems, automated development and diagnostic workflows, and operate self-hosted multi-GPU LLM infrastructure for inference, experimentation, and training research. My independent work includes vision-language document extraction, hybrid search, tool-using agents, reverse-engineering workflows, and experiments with LoRA and reinforcement learning.

I am most interested in technically deep work with room for independent investigation and implementation, particularly architecture, debugging, reliability, security, systems, automation, and LLM infrastructure. I am less interested in roles dominated by routine feature delivery than in problems where understanding the system deeply and exercising sound technical judgment materially changes the outcome.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Modernized the company’s primary Java SaaS platform from a heavily static, tightly coupled codebase with no automated test suite, introducing Spring-based dependency injection, separation of concerns, and layered testable component design; established the architecture and testing patterns now used for new development across the platform

Led end-to-end development of a major credit bureau integration supporting FCRA-governed consumer credit workflows, spanning backend services, database design, external APIs, frontend workflows, and sensitive data handling

Built an MCP-based agentic engineering environment with context-optimized tools for compilation, deployment, testing, production-log analysis, database tracing, and CI/CD diagnostics, supporting autonomous issue-to-PR workflows and cross-layer debugging across Playwright, Tomcat, and MariaDB

Diagnosed and eliminated recurring database deadlocks through query analysis, indexing, transaction-isolation changes, and application-level refactoring; built database-tracing tooling to correlate connections, transactions, and queries to identify inefficient access patterns

Designed and implemented core domain models and reusable data structures, including a tagging framework that became foundational infrastructure for subsequent features

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and maintained a Java/Spring + React pricing application used to optimize Open Box retail pricing; improved performance and reliability through deadlock diagnosis, database indexing, refactoring, and migration of stored-procedure logic into testable application code

Built a production service from the ground up to process and publish discount data to downstream pricing/POS systems, including CI/CD, integration testing, transaction conflict/retry handling, rate limiting, timeouts, and downstream failure handling

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed scalable Java/Spring services on AWS processing 4M+ finance-related events per week across multiple geographic regions, including business mapping, transformation, and downstream financial-data workflows

Contributed to services supporting revenue reporting, tax compliance, and accounting using TDD and 90%+ instruction test coverage; worked with SQS, S3, EC2 ASGs, CloudFormation, Lambda
positions.insights: Software Development, Spring Boot and +5 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on Kindle rendering/layout systems with a focus on non-Latin language support; maintained and improved typographic regression-testing infrastructure and migrated testing from a local workstation to Amazon internal infrastructure with automated deployment

Integrated runtime analysis tooling into layout-related build pipelines to catch memory/addressing issues before release; also supported Yocto-based firmware workflows and physical device testing/debugging
positions.insights: Software Development, Amazon Web Services (AWS) and +3 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led much of the decommissioning and migration of a ~60k LOC ColdFusion application to a modern stack using Spring, RabbitMQ, MongoDB, MSSQL, and Angular, working with substantial autonomy

Developed and supported internal tools used to manage customer-facing sites, working directly with non-technical users to improve workflows and operational efficiency
Contributed across the full stack to add a new returns process used across 5+ customer-facing sites, including implementation, refactoring, and documentation
positions.insights: Software Development, Spring Boot and +6 skills
